column1: # Project-authored casual Hinglish forms and variant clusters (CC0-1.0; see ../README.md and docs/HINGLISH.md).
# Columns (TAB separated): native (Devanagari, used to look up the news frequency, or "-") <TAB>
#   spellings "roman:percent,roman:percent,..." (first = canonical; percents are the share of the word's uses) <TAB>
#   optional absolute count, used as a floor when the news corpus under-represents casual chat.
# A cluster is one native word with its spellings: nahi / nhi / nahin / nai.
